items: MEASURE FOR THE BEST FIT! With your knee slightly bent, use the center of the kneecap as your starting point, measure your thigh circumference 14 cm or 5 1/2 inches above the kneecap (Point A). Measure your calf circumference 12 cm or 4 3/4 inches below the kneecap (Point B). Refer to the sizing chart in the product images for your size. If your measurements are split between two sizes, choose the size that best fits the thigh.

items.label: STABILITY & PAIN RELIEF
items.value: The Omega knee pad surrounds the kneecap to absorb pressure and distribute force evenly. The compression knit and patellar pad alleviate muscles and tissue for knee pain relief, boost metabolism to improve circulation and increase proprioception for better joint coordination.

items.label: BETTER PERFORMANCE
items.value: Designed with active wear in mind. Thanks to the compression knit, the Sports Knee Support works with the movements of the knee to help relieve strain, prevent overload and limit the risk of injury. This allows you to train longer and harder for better performance.

items.label: OPTIMAL COMFORT & FIT
items.value: The anatomical design of the knee brace ensures a perfect fit and freedom of movement. Low-profile design with grip technology provides a secure, no-slip fit for all-day comfort. The lightweight 3D Airknit material is breathable and moisture-wicking to keep you cool and dry.

items.label: DURABLE & MACHINE MASHABLE
items.value: Bauerfeind sports knee braces are made in Germany and meet the highest standards of quality, comfort, and effectiveness. Crafted with premium materials, they are durable, reliable, machine washable, and easy to wear.

items.label: 100% SATISFACTION GUARANTEED
items.value: With proper use and care, our products are designed to last. We stand behind everything we sell. In case you are not satisfied with your order, we offer FREE RETURNS within 30 days for a refund or replacement.

items.value: SATISFACTION GUARANTEED OR YOUR MONEY BACK
